integrity: The limit and sign classification follow from explicit generator, reflected-gap semigroup, renewal mixing, and monotone covariance arguments; numerical assertions corroborate finite cases and integral evaluations only.
scientific_limitations: Stationary mean-finite Pareto resetting with alpha>1, full deterministic-step configuration reset on infinite nearest-neighbor SSEP, and diffusive R-to-infinity spatial scaling. No finite ring or alpha<=1 theorem; microscopic or time-correlations not evaluated; novelty subject to independent priority check.
title: A signed macroscopic correlation law for Pareto-reset exclusion
